source.note: Response-only case: OutboundTransformer.TransformResponse for a compact upstream reply containing a reasoning item with encrypted_content plus a message item. The upstream body below is the verbatim respBody string literal from the Go test (L147-164). inbound_http, unified_request, selected_channel, outbound_http and client_http are null because the outbound response unit test does not exercise those stages. unified_response is an extension field (not one of the six required sections) recording the llm.Response the transformer must produce.

upstream_http._comment: httpclient.Response constructed by the Go test: StatusCode=200, Body=respBody, Request.RequestType='compact' (used by the transformer to dispatch to transformCompactResponse). body_json is the verbatim respBody literal.

unified_response._comment: Extension field recording the llm.Response produced by transformCompactResponse. Byte-asserted by the Go test: RequestType==compact, APIFormat==openai/responses_compact, Model=='gpt-4o', Choices empty, Compact.ID=='resp_001', Compact.CreatedAt==1764967971, Compact.Object=='response.compaction', Compact.Instructions=='Be concise', len(Compact.Output)==1 (reasoning item is folded into the message), Output[0].ID=='msg_000', Role=='assistant', *Content.Content=='Hello', *ReasoningContent=='Reasoning summary', *ReasoningSignature=='gAAAAAB...', Usage 139/438/577, CompletionTokensDetails.ReasoningTokens==64. Top-level id/created/object mirror Compact per compact_outbound.go transformCompactResponse L104-118. usage.ToUsage() (usage.go) always populates prompt_tokens_details.cached_tokens (0 here); zero-valued sibling detail fields of llm.Usage are omitted in this transcript for brevity.
